frontText: Navy 59 centered on a yellow door card. Dashed cut-line border. No other printed text.

items.title: Coral Sea haven

havens.graticule: In the sea east of Australia, between the printed 20°S and 40°S lines and west of the printed 160°E meridian. The population 1 square sits just west of 160°E; the anchor is southwest of that square.
havens.namePlate: A blank white name plate is printed on the Australian continent, west of the anchor, with no pointer. The ruins text is on that yellow land.

printedRoutes.from: off-sticker west (Jakarta sea lane on door 63)
printedRoutes.notes: A blue sea lane enters from the west edge north of Australia, crosses the printed 140°E meridian south of New Guinea, and reaches the haven anchor.
The same blue line continues past the anchor toward the southeast and leaves the sticker. No second city or haven is printed on this sticker.

reconRoutes.symbol: asterisk on each card (any city of that color; duplicates allowed)
reconRoutes.cardIcons: Two red cards, each with a white asterisk.

redRegionLines: A horizontal red line runs east along the printed 20°S parallel, from the east coast of Australia (Queensland) out to the edge of the shallow sea. It crosses the blue sea lane north of the haven.

specialAreas.name: compass rose
specialAreas.notes: A compass rose is printed in the dark ocean at the northeast. No rules text.

mechanics.recon: 2 red cards, asterisks (duplicates allowed), no supply center, opens door 19.
mechanics.notes: Population 1. The haven is a port. No supply cache is printed.

summary: Ruined haven east of Australia, population 1, unnamed until the first move. A sea lane arrives from the west (the Jakarta lane) and continues southeast off the sticker. Recon here with 2 red cards, duplicates allowed, and no supply center, opens door 19. A red region line runs east along 20°S.
